## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.InvalidOperationException`
**Message:** Invoke oder BeginInvoke kann für ein Steuerelement erst aufgerufen werden, wenn das Fensterhandle erstellt wurde.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
We reproduced the same exception in the built application: save and reload a layout, then File → Open → Replace with another connection file.
The old Connections pane had been destroyed but was still receiving the file-loaded event, so it tried to rebuild a tree whose window handle no longer existed.
The local fix disconnects the disposed pane from those events. The full 7,323-test suite passes, and both normal File/Open and File/Open after layout reload now display the replacement tree withou...

notes: Local #200 fix: disposed Connections pane unsubscribes service, settings, theme and synchronizer events. Full suite 7323/7323 passed; normal and reloaded-layout File/Open show replacement-only without the handle exception. See CATCH-UP-PLAN-2026-09-29.md for artifact hash. Code not published and not reporter-confirmed. Approved response published and read back: https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/issues/200#issuecomment-5887651448
